title: MechanismDefinition
description: The fundamental, recursive object. A robot is a mechanism; a mechanism may also be a reusable submechanism referenced by other mechanisms' components.

id.description: Stable identifier for this mechanism definition, referenced by other mechanisms' components.

name.description: A human-readable name for this mechanism.

version.description: An optional version string for this mechanism definition.

robot_type.description: The type/supplier/grouping this mechanism describes, when applicable.

classification.description: Descriptive, non-structural classification of this mechanism.

units.description: The default unit system for this mechanism's quantities.

frames.description: The frames defined by this mechanism.

bodies.description: The rigid bodies (links) that make up this mechanism.

joints.description: The kinematic joints connecting this mechanism's bodies.

constraints.description: Explicit constraints (e.g. loop closures) for parallel or closed-chain mechanisms.

components.description: Submechanisms instantiated within this mechanism, enabling recursive composition.

connections.description: Explicit connections mounting this mechanism's components to one another.

kinematics.description: The kinematic representation(s) (DH, PoE, constraint-based, ...) describing this mechanism.

interfaces.description: This mechanism's named, explicit mounting/reference points, keyed by interface name (e.g. "base", "tool").

metadata.description: Opaque, application-defined data carried alongside this mechanism.
